# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

O Topa Ka Pathian, Nangsia, Nangma honghe thei tu a kei hong vawtpa na hi sia a pha tak in katel hi. Katha zawnna te ah Nang thahatna kong suang a, kazawnna te ah Nang hauna kong suang hi. Pathian a dang om ngawl a Nangbek na hi a, a kiting tawntung Honghu tawntungpa na hi hi.
